summary: SuperX AI Technology Ltd (a foreign private issuer, Singapore-based) filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of independent director Hong Man Herman Lee effective May 13, 2026, citing no disagreement with the company. The board simultaneously appointed Wei Shao as independent director and chair of the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, and reconstituted the Audit, Compensation, and Nominating committees. The changes are ordinary director succession and committee reorganization, not a forced departure or special situation. No deal terms, shareholder actions, or strategic events are involved. This is a routine governance update, not a special situation.
